facts.text: Kip Moore earns his ninth #1 hit and first since 2017's 'More Girls Like You'
She's Mine' completes the longest climb to number one, 28 weeks, since Sara Evan's 'A Little Bit Stronger took 30 weeks.
Moore now has the second most #1 hits among men, breaking his tie with David Nail

Randy Houser's 'No Stone Unturned' becomes Randy Houser's fourth top five hit, and second from album Magnolia, after 'What Whiskey Does' marking the first time in his career he's earned two top fives from one album
Runaway June earn their third top five hit as 'Head over Heels' rises 12-10
She Mine' falling 1-11 after leading the chart for one week is the largest drop from #1 since Chris Janson's 'Drunk Girl' made the 1-19 drop back in 2018
Carly Pearce's 'I Hope You're Happy Now' returns to number one for the third time, making this just the second song to do so since Ingrid Andress' 'More Hearts Than Mine'
She's Mine' becomes the first song to spend 29 weeks on the chart since Tim McGraw's Neon Church' back in 2019
Maddie & Tae debut with their first duet with Dierks Bentley, 'Lay Here With Me' enters the chart at #19
Maren Morris earns her first top five since 2018's 'I'll Be the Moon' with Dierks Bentley, and fourth overall
Carly Pearce and Lee Brice spend a 5th week at #1 with 'I Hope You're Happy Now,' the second longest for Pearce and longest for Brice
Kip Moore spends a 30th week on the chart with 'She's Mine,' the third song to do so after Sara Evans 'A Little Bit Stronger' at 32 weeks and Randy Houser's 'Like a Cowboy' at 30 weeks.
The week's Greatest Gainer belongs to 'It Don't Rain in California' rising 17-14
Randy Houser earns his third #1 with 'No Stone Unturned' rising 3-1, his first since 'Like A Cowboy,' which topped the chart 5 years ago today.
Houser's gap between #1s (5 years) is the longest gap since Sugarland's 'Still the Same' topped the chart in 2019, over seven years after 'Run' led the chart in 2012.
Little Big Town claim their tenth top 10 hit, making them the group with the second most top ten hits (tied with The Band Perry and Zac Brown Band)
Luke Combs returns with 'Does to Me' debuting at #20
Randy Houser spends a second week at #1 with 'No Stone Unturned'
Runaway June earn their third top five hit as 'Head Over Heels' rises 6-5, after the #3-peaking 'Lipstick' and the #4-peaking 'Wild West'
Miranda Lambert hits the top ten as 'Bluebird' rises 11-10 this week
Kelsea Ballerini's 'Hope Coming Queen' spends as 28th week on the chart, falling 4-7, making it just the 16th song to do so
Carrie Underwood vaults to number one this week as 'Drinking Alone' jumps 6-1 to earn Underwood her 17th #1 hit, extending her record

Underwood also earns her third number one from album 'Cry Pretty,' her third album do so, after 'Play On' and 'Storyteller' and is the first album since Randall Kings self-titled debut did so last year
Cody Jinks earns his third top ten this week as 'It Don't Rain in California' flies 12-7 this week
The Dixie Chicks return for the first time since 2011 with 'Gaslighter' debuting at #18.
Ashley McBryde follows up first #1 hit, 'One Night Standards' with 'Martha Divine,' which enters the chart at #20.
Gabby Barrett earns her first number one hit as 'The Good Ones' rises 2-1 this week.
The song follows her #2-peaking 'I Hope' from last June.
Little Big Town push 3-2 with 'Sugar Coat,' earning the group their fifth song to reach the top 2.
Carrie Underwood's 'Drinking Alone' slides 1-3 after leading the chart for a single week, making the track her sixth to lead for only one week.
David Nail earns his first solo top ten hit since 2018's 'Old Man's Symphony' which reached #4. He rises 12-10 this week with 'Forgiveness.'
Gabby Barrett stays atop the chart for a second week with 'The Good Ones' as it becomes the second song this year to pass 500 plays
Randall King earns his fourth top five hit as 'She Gone' rises 6-4.
Cody Jinks earns his third top five hit with 'It Don’t Rain in California' rising 7-5
Brandy Clark debuts on the chart for the first time with 'Who You Thought I Was' entering at #17. Clark gained significant airplay outside the chart in 2017-2019 with 'Love Can Go to Hell'
William Michael Morgan returns to the chart with 'Talking to a Girl' debuting at #19, while Jon Pardi debuts at #20 with 'Ain't Always the Cowboy'
The Good Ones' leads the top of the chart for third straight week.
This is the longest leader by a former American Idol contestant ever, tied with 4 Carrie Underwood number ones.
These songs are 'Temporary Home' (2010), 'Someday When I Stop Loving You' (2011), 'Something In the Water' (2014) and 'Southbound' (2019)
Head Over Heels' returns to the chart's top five this week, rising 6-5.
Little Big Town score their fourth number one hit with 'Sugar Coat' rising 2-1 this week.
This is the group's first #1 since 2017, when they led the chart for 3 weeks with 'When Someone Stops Loving You'
Cody Jinks scores a career best rank as 'It Don't Rain in California' rises 4-2, passing the #4 peak of 'No Words'
Runaway June hit the top 3 for the second time as 'Head Over Heels' rises 5-3, matching their career best rank with 2017's 'Lipstick'
Gabby Barrett falls 1-6 this week with 'The Good Ones,' which spends a 28th week on the chart.
Little Big Town hold the #1 position with 'Sugar Coat'
David Nail rises 8-5 with 'Forgiveness,' his first top five hit as a soloist since 2018's 'Old Man Symphony'
Tanya Tucker earns her first top ten hit as 'Big My Flowers Now' rises 12-9
Carrie Underwood follows up her two consecutive number one hits, 'Southbound' and 'Drinking Alone' with 'Spinning Bottles' debuting at #18
Kenny Chesney likewise follows his two number one hits, 'Better Boat' and 'Tip of My Tongue,' as 'Here and Now' debuts at #20.
For a third straight week, Little Big Town top the chart with 'Sugar Coat'
Little Big Town now have five #1 hits that have all spent at least 3 weeks atop the chart.
Randall King pushes to #2 with 'She Gone' becoming his fourth straight signle to reach the chart's top 2.
Travis Denning earns his first top five as 'After a Few' rises 6-4 this week.
Miranda Lambert's 'Bluebird' flies into the top five, rising 8-5, earning the singer her 24th top five single.
Randall King keeps his perfect record on the Top Country Songs chart this week as 'She Gone' rises 2-1 becoming his fourth straight #1 hit.
Maddie and Tae earn their 11th top ten hit and 6th from album 'The Way It Feels'
This makes the album just the 7th in the chart's history to earn 6 or more top ten hits, and first since Ronnie Dunn's 'Tattooed Heart' in 2018.
Kristian Bush earns his first solo charting single since last year's 'In Between Disasters' as 'Burning Flowers' enters the chart at #19.
Tim McGraw rounds out the chart with his latest single, 'I Called Mama,' which debuts at #20.
She Gone' became Randall King's fourth number one last week, and it stays atop the chart this week.
Lady A earn their 21st top five hit this week as 'What I'm Leavin' For' rises 7-5, fourth most in the chart's history
The trio are behind Miranda Lambert's 24, Carrie Underwood's 25, and Taylor Swift's 26.
Mickey Guyton scores her third chart entry this week as 'What Are You Gonna Tell Her' debuts at #20.
Her' follows the #1 song of 2015, 'Better Than You Left Me,' and 2018's #3-peaking 'Nice Things.'
Maddie & Tae claim their sixth #1 hit with 'Lay Here With Me' featuring Dierks Bentley. The song is the duo's fifth from album 'The Way It Feels' a record among all duos
Dierks Bentley also scores his third #1. His last two #1 hits were also duets, 'Different For Girls' which featured Elle King, and 'I'll Be the Moon' featuring Maren Morris.
Ashley McBryde earns her second top five hit as 'Martha Divine' blasts 6-2, following her 2-week leader 'One Night Standards'

The Dixie Chicks return to the top five for the first time since 2010's 'Not Ready to Make Sense' setting the record for the longest break between reaching the region. This week, they rise 7-3 with 'Gaslighter'
The Dixie Chicks are now the second all female trio to score three top five hits, following 2010's 'Travelin' Soldier' and 'Not Ready to Make Nice.' The trio follow Runaway June.
Lay Here With Me' holds #1 for a second straight week.
Carrie Underwood earns a fifth top ten single from album Cry Pretty with 'Spinning Bottles' rising 11-9.
Maren Morris earns a second from album Girl and her sixth in her career as 'To Hell & Back' rises 12-10.
Thomas Rhett debuts for the first time since 2014's 'Get Me Some of That,' as 'Be A Light' debuts at #20.
Be A Light' features Reba McEntire, Hillary Scott, Christian singer Chris Tomlin and Keith Urban, making it the first song to feature four artists to chart.

Maddie and Tae earn their fifth single to lead the chart for 3 or more weeks at 'Lay Here With Me' tops the chart, following 'After the Storm Blows Through' (4 weeks), 'Friends Don't' (3 Weeks), 'Die From a Broken Heart' (7 Weeks) and 'One Heart to Another' (4 Weeks)
The song is also Dierks Bentley's third song to lead the chart for 3 or more weeks, following 'Different For Girls' (3 weeks) and 'I'll Be the Moon' (4 weeks).
Kip Moore debuts at #19 with 'Crazy For You Tonight,' following his record setting single 'She's Mine'
Brantley Gilbert makes his first chart appearance since 'Stone Cold Sober' reached #7 in 2016.
Martha Divine' rises 3-1 to become Ashley McBryde's second #1 single.
The song follows 'One Night Standards,' which led the chart for two weeks earlier this year.
This makes 'McBryde' the first artist this year to have two #1 hits.
Krisitan Bush earns the Greatest Gainer rising 12-10 this week with 'Burning Flowers'
Randall King follows up his four straight #1 hits with 'Burn It At Both Ends' debuting at #20.
Maddie and Tae return to #1 for a fourth week with 'Lay Here With Me' becoming the group's third song to lead the chart for 4 or more weeks.
Dierks Bentley also earns his second to spent four weeks at #1, after 2017's 'Different For Girls.'
The Dixie Chicks return to their #3 peak with 'Gaslighter' rising 4-3.
Carrie Underwood also pushes forward 8-7 this week with 'Spinning Bottles' swapping places with Jon Pardi's 'Ain't Always the Cowboy'
The Dixie Chicks, recently renamed The Chicks, earn their first #1 since 2010 as 'Gaslighter' rises 3-1 this week.
The group set the record for longest gap between #1s, having last topped the chart on August 19, 2010 with 'Not Ready to Make Nice,' 9 years 10 months and 13 days prior.

Brandy Clark earns her first top five as a soloist as 'Who You Thought I Was' rises 6-4. Clark previously reached the top five six other times as a songwriter, even topping the chart with the Band Perry's 2013 hit 'Better Dig Two'
Jon Pardi rounds out the top five earning his 7th top five hit with 'Ain't Always the Cowboy' moving 8-5.
Kenny Chesney enters the top ten with 'Here and Now' rising 11-10, marking the first time the artist had four straight top ten hits since 2016
The Chicks lead the chart for a second straight week with 'Gaslighter,' becoming the group's second song to spend multiple weeks at #1, after the two week reign of 'Travelin' Solider' in 2010.
The entire top five remain in the same position as last week.

Mickey Guyton blasts into the top ten, earning the singer her third top ten hit, 'What Are You Gonna Tell Her?' moving 13-9. The song follows #1 hit 'Better Than You Left Me' and #3-peaking 'Nice Things'
Tim McGraw likewise enters the chart's top ten with 'I Called Mama' moving 14-10, giving the singer his 15th top ten hit of the CS Era.
Lady A, make their first debut since dropping the "Antebellum" from their name as 'Champagne Night' debuts at #20.
The Chicks spend a third straight week at #1 with 'Gaslighter,' which becomes the trio's longest #1 single.
William Michael Morgan earns his first trip to the top two since 2017's 'Lonesomeville' as 'Talking to a Girl' rises 3-2
Brandy Clark continues to rise with her first charting single 'Who You Thought I Was' rising 4-3.
Luke Combs and Eric Church continue to set records with 'Does to Me' spending a 19th week on the chart, all outside the top ten.
William Michael Morgan earns his first #1 hit since 2017's 'Missing' as 'Talking to a Girl' rises 2-1.
The song is Morgan's second charttopper to feature the word girl, following his debut 'I Met a Girl,' which became the #1 hit of 2016
Jon Pardi blasts 5-2 with 'Ain't Always the Cowboy,' becoming his fifth song to reach the top two and second from the album Heartache Medication, following the title track that reached #2.
Kristian Bush earns his sixth top five hit as 'Burning Flowers' flies 6-3 this week.

Carrie Underwood is the Greatest Gainer this week, earning a record 26th top five hit with 'Spinning Bottles' jumping 8-4. The song ties Underwood with Taylor Swift's long standing record of most top five hits on the chart.
Talking to a Girl' spends a second week at #1 becoming William Michael Morgan's third #1 hit to spend more than one week atop the chart.
Maddie & Tae debut big at #15 with 'Water in His Wine Glass' becoming their highest debuting song since 'One Heart To Another' debut at #14 last year.
The Chicks followup their previous #1, 'Gaslighter,' which ranks at #9 this week, with 'Sleep at Night' debuting at #19
Parker McCollum earns his first charting single as 'Pretty Heart' debuts at #20.

Brandy Clark earns her first #1 as an artist with 'Who You Thought I Was' jumping 5-1. Clark previously led the chart as a songwriter way back in 2012 when the Band Perry's 'Better Dig Two' topped the chart.

Clark has also written seven other charting songs, including the top five hits, Kacey Musgraves 'The Trailer Song,' Toby Keith's 'Drunk Americans,' Jennifer Nettles 'Unlove You,' Leann Rimes' 'Crazy Women' and Miranda Lambert's 'Mama's Broken Heart.'
Kip Moore enters the top ten with 'Crazy For You Tonight' becoming his second top ten hit from album Wild World and his twelfth overall
New to the chart this week is Scotty McCreery's 'In Between' entering at #19.
Eric Church also enters the chart with 'Stick That In Your Country Song' debuting at #20.
William Michael Morgan's 'Talking to a Girl' returns to the #1 spot for a third week becoming his third single to lead the chart for three or more weeks
Maddie and Tae blast into the top ten with 'Water In His Wine Glass' rising 14-9 becoming the duo's seventh from album The Way It Feels, a record among all duos
Brantley Gilbert earns his first top ten hit since 2015's 'Stone Cold Sober' reached #7
Luke Combs has the week's only new debut as 'Lovin' On You Enters at #20
